lookup_khot_embedding_by_atomic_number: lookup the k-hot binary embedding vector for a given atomic number from KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
get_cgcnn_elemental_embedding: get the original CGCNN k-hot elemental embedding for element 6 (carbon) from the dictionary
iterate_all_khot_embeddings: iterate over all 100 k-hot elemental embeddings in KHOT_EMBEDDINGS to inspect their binary vectors
check_embedding_dimension: check the dimension of each k-hot embedding vector which is 92 features per element
summarize_khot_embeddings: summarize the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary structure and the number of elements covered from 1 to 100
